summary: This 8-K details a liability management transaction by JELD-WEN Holding, Inc. and subsidiary JELD-WEN, Inc. On September 29, 2026, JELD-WEN entered a commitment and consent letter with holders collectively owning approximately 94.5% of its 4.875% Senior Notes due 2027 and 72.2% of its Replacement 2023 Term B Loans (Existing 2028 Term Loans). The Issuer agreed to commence a Notes Exchange Offer for any and all 2027 Notes into new first lien secured notes due 2031, at an exchange price of 100.00% of face value for holders providing backstop commitments or participating in a concurrent new money notes offer, or 93.00% for other eligible holders. A consent solicitation seeks to amend the existing indenture to eliminate substantially all restrictive covenants, certain default provisions, and modify merger and defeasance provisions. The filing outlines a broad exchange and liability management exercise intended to extend maturities and add security; watchbackstop participation, new money terms, potential overhang for non-participating holders, and the regulatory clock for the exchange offer and consent solicitation.
